spec.name: Furniture Vampire Wardrobe
spec.description: Wide blackwood wardrobe with crimson double doors, raised gothic panels, sculpted brass bat handles and a stepped central crown. Connected, axis-aligned construction fits within 0..32 × 0..32 × 0..16 with clear outer margins. Front faces negative Z; all 26 cuboids have individually packed, non-overlapping cube nets.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: wide gothic blackwood wardrobe with double crimson paneled doors, brass bat-shaped handles and a stepped pointed crown. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
